codeWindows.name: damage-tag-immune-rule-loop
codeWindows.boundary: Reviewed any-matching-rule loop; live installed rules separate.

interpretation.ordinary: On the false-IFix, non-special damage-type compiled route, GetFinalAttackValue calls ApplyDamageModifer before _GetFinalDamageScale, and multiplies the returned Double by calcResult.value. The reviewed non-debug continuation returns that Double.
interpretation.scaleAggregation: _GetFinalDamageScale initializes a Double accumulator to 1, obtains a list count, visits indices from zero while below that count, calls _GetDamageScale for each selected element and multiplies each returned Double into the accumulator. A non-positive count returns 1.
interpretation.special: On the false-IFix LifeDrain branch, GetFinalAttackValue returns calcResult.value directly through the common restoring epilogue, bypassing its ordinary ApplyDamageModifer and zone-aggregation calls. This does not prove the caller or later HP settlement bypasses other logic.
interpretation.zoneValues: New pack zone arrays start at 1 on both sides. A named modification adds its value to one side for an additive zone, or multiplies that side by 1+value for a multiplicative zone. Missing names log and return. Built-in damage/skill/ignite/broken/enhanced/vulnerable contributions are added to selected side cells during zone evaluation. Finite zone output is max(A*D,0), except a non-multiplicative merged zone uses max(A+D-1,0). Damage-type zones additionally return neutral 1 when type/mask selection is invalid.
interpretation.modifierOrder: The ordinary pack modifier path visits attacker modifiers before defender modifiers, selecting matching EnableSide and running optional condition sequences before ordered processors. Each processor checks ProcessTiming and health support. After both sides, actor attributes are refreshed. BeforeCalculation is submitted by DamageAction before its calculation; GetFinalAttackValue submits AfterCalculation before zone aggregation.
interpretation.precision: BlackboardDouble convenience resolution used by DamageScaleProcessor and ModifyCalcResult returns Single. DamageScaleProcessor widens that result for the zone write. ModifyCalcResult performs Single multiply and Single plus-one before widening the factor and multiplying calcResult.value as Double.
interpretation.processorExceptions: AttackCriticalRateProcessor advertises BeforeCalculation but its selected false-IFix ProcessDamagePackDataInternal is a no-op. IgnoreShieldProcessor is BeforeCalculation and sets pack.ignoreShield. Do not infer arithmetic from stored processor names.
interpretation.normalFormula: After pack scaling, normal-health CalculateDamage rolls CriticalRate and uses 1+CriticalDamageIncrease only on a true roll. Its Double product includes attacker WeaknessDmgScalar, DEF factor, 1-defender ShelterDmgScalar, nonnegative typed resistance/taken factor and defenderPoiseFactor. The latter default getter returns 1. IgniteDamageSet and PhysicalInfliction independently multiply their attacker scalar. Normal-health LifeDrain returns the pack result with false critical/blocked and null report. Independent health returns current calcResult.value with false outputs and null report.
interpretation.defense: Real damage DEF factor is 1. Otherwise DEF at/above the negative epsilon uses 1/(1+Double(efficiencyOfDEF)*DEF). Below that threshold it is 2-pow(Double(Single(1-efficiencyOfDEF)),-DEF). The coefficient getter is the named BattleConst efficiencyOfDEF property, returning Single.
interpretation.typedResistance: Physical/Fire/Pulse/Cryst/Natural/Ether use defender (1-Resistance/100)*DamageTakenScalar; CalculateDamage clamps this resulting factor to at least zero. Real uses 1. All factors consume the refreshed actor snapshots.
interpretation.hpSettlement: On the ordinary HP damage route, cancelled modifiers return early and damage immunity cancels with DamageImmune. Unless IgnoreShield is selected, the absolute negative finalDelta traverses the shield collection in reverse index order; the residual updates modifier.value. Near-zero residual cancels with ShieldBlock. Final damage delta is -max(value,0). The caller submits oldHP+delta through virtual SetHpInternal and records afterHP-beforeHP as realDelta. The base setter clamps to [0,maxHp], with explicit HP floor, undead and server-death protections. Living unprotected base targets follow the simple clamp; overrides and event mutation are not assumed absent in general.
interpretation.shieldConsumption: Empty absorption dictionaries use (ratio,scale)=(1,1); a missing damage key in a nonempty dictionary uses (0,1). With positive finite scale, desired absorption is input*ratio, required shield is desired/scale. Insufficient finite shield leaves input-shield*scale, sets shield value zero and decrements count; sufficient or infinite-value mode leaves input-desired and decrements stored value/count. Consumption policies then refresh flags; absorbAllDmgWhenConsume can replace the insufficient-case residual by input-desired. Consumed/near-zero-input/near-zero-ratio shields pass through unchanged. Controller order is reverse container order; effective sort/priority insertion is not claimed.
interpretation.feedback: Successful default HP processing reaches _OnAttacked. It conditionally emits receiver OnTakeDamage/OnTakeCriticalDamage before source OnOutputDamage/OnOutputCriticalDamage. Requested final damage and real HP loss are separate context values. The default LifeSteal branch requires distinct source/receiver, negative realDelta and positive source LifeSteal; its heal pack base is -realDelta*Double(Single(LifeSteal)), before normal healing modifiers/scaling. Therefore overkill request is not the steal base.
interpretation.shieldCapacity: On the valid false-IFix initialization route, valueCalculation returns a Double which is multiplied by the widened Single shield attribute factor. The shield buff owner supplies ShieldTakenIncrease and its source supplies ShieldOutputIncrease; the latter is zero for an invalid source. The factor uses Single(ownerTaken+1) followed by Single addition of sourceOutput. The resulting Double initializes both max and remaining value. No clamp of this attribute factor is visible in the selected getter.
interpretation.shieldComparisonBoundary: Stored AddShield context is PriorityQueue<ObjectPtr<ShieldInst>>. Shared compiled Add compares ObjectPtr instance UIDs using unsigned UInt32 comparison, inserts before the first greater UID and appends after equals. Valid normally resolved contexts and an unchanged ordinary container yield descending UID consumption, latest insertion first on equal UID. This body does not call ShieldInst.CompareTo; config priority/remainingTime do not determine this compiled order. UID allocation chronology is separate.
interpretation.enemyPartHp: False-IFix part HP/maxHP accessors forward to the main body when data.useMainBodyHp is true; otherwise base accessors. Part SetHpInternal performs no write when this flag is true; otherwise base setter. Sharing is not itself a forwarding write.
interpretation.partTransfer: PartAttributes creates another main-body modifier from part CalculateDamage result times widened Single damageRatio, subject to successful normal calculation/application and positive-ratio gates. MainBodyAttributes queues a main-body ExtraTarget with struck part as transferredSource; it calculates that target independently then multiplies its damage by the source part ratio. Extra-target flag prevents recursive queuing. Positive poiseRatio can admit that target even without positive damageRatio. PartAttributes passes triggerTakeDamageEvent=false; extra-target passes true. OnPartsBeHit is separate from HP loss.
interpretation.transferredHp: Selected ApplyTransferredModifier HP path checks cancellation/immunity, writes HP+finalDelta through virtual SetHpInternal and records readback delta. It does not traverse ordinary shield absorption or _OnAttacked LifeSteal/source-output dispatch. Its Boolean admits receiver before/take-damage notifications. Do not replay the full ordinary damage pipeline for transfer. False-IFix AbilitySystemForGod.ApplyModifier returns Failed.
interpretation.processorAdmission: Default CanProcessDamagePackData rejects LifeDrain, compares requested timing with virtual processTiming slot 8, then requires mask bit NormalHealth=1 or IndependentHealth=2 from virtual modifiableHealthTypeMask slot 6 according to defender health. The selected concrete getters and mask enum are authenticated. LifeDrain bypasses all these processors through this admission path.
interpretation.legacyProcessorNoOps: False-IFix AttackCriticalRateProcessor, AttackerAtkProcessor, AttackerCriticalDamageProcessor, AttackerPenProcessor and DefenderDefProcessor internal bodies return without resolving stored addition/scale/multiplier or changing pack state. Do not assign legacy field arithmetic by class name.
interpretation.independentHealthProcessor: DamageIndependentHealthProcessor is AfterCalculation and supports only IndependentHealth. Its default body multiplies calcResult.value by Double(Single(resolved multiplier)); unlike ModifyCalcResult this factor does not add one.
interpretation.immunityOrder: Default LifeDrain returns false. A true predicate with entity/query argument 11 returns immune. If predicate 78 is true, return NOT bit 19 of the incoming mask immediately. Otherwise, if predicate 79 is true, return NOT any bit in 0xc0000 immediately. Only when neither latter predicate is true does the optional allowed mask reject zero intersection, followed by damage-tag rules. Ignoring skill/dodge immunity here is an early false return, not a request to keep checking later restrictions. Predicate constants correlate with named PredefinedQuery/Tag enum entries; loaded predicate definitions/providers remain separate.
interpretation.allowedDamageMasks: Default refresh clears the nullable effective mask when no requests remain. Otherwise it begins at All and ANDs every stored request mask. This is an intersection of allowed masks, not a union. Requests and reversions refresh the effective value.
interpretation.damageTagQuery: Selected rule evaluation succeeds on the first matching GameplayTagQuery. The default HasAny query walks each damage tag descriptor ancestor chain looking for a query tag descriptor. HasAll instead requires an exact Int32 tag-id match for every query entry. ExceptAny and ExceptAll both reject any exact id intersection, with different traversal order; neither is inferred as a conventional negation of HasAny/HasAll. Empty HasAny input is false; empty HasAll requirement is true; valid empty exception inputs yield true. Descriptor loading/resolution, valid collections and false relevant IFix remain conditions.
interpretation.conditionSequence: Null modifier condition runs processors directly; an invalid nonnull condition skips them. A valid condition receives the damage context on its child environments, executes with resetAfterExecute=true and is removed again before processing. Sequence default execution visits stored indices, skips Ended children and refuses other positive executing states. It samples context.executePolicy before each child. LastSucceed requires a true child result; LastFailed is consumed/reset to LastSucceed and requires false, rather than permanently negating the whole sequence. Other policies throw. Eligible empty/exhausted sequences return true; child semantics and context providers remain separate.
interpretation.attributeRefresh: False-IFix DamagePackData._DumpAttributes loops ascending attribute indices, calls Attributes.GetValue and stores each returned Double at that same index in attackerAttributes or defenderAttributes. The two direct call sites distinguish sides; ordinary ApplyDamageModifer reaches this refresh after both modifier collections. This is conditional on normally resolved actors, valid stable arrays, normal getter returns and no alternate patch; entry-only observations do not prove completed snapshots.

evidenceBoundary.exact: Selected native inputs, named method entries/signatures/slots, reviewed entry/unwind-owned byte windows, instance/static fields, scalar literals and typed enum defaults. Stored caller MethodSpecs and closed arguments separately checked.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Reviewed default compiled algorithms for zones, modifiers, normal-health formula, shield consumption and base HP settlement. Valid inputs and normally returning helpers are required; IFix, virtual variants and callback state changes remain explicit conditions. This authenticates bytes and metadata, not full instruction-program/CFG proofs or live execution.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Effective config/live IFix, complete target/snapshot producers, modifier condition/health context, generic provider runtime resolution, network/death policy, callback mutation, RNG, shield UID chronology and live container mutation. Stored config projection is separate.

damageFormula.ordinary: packValue * attacker.WeaknessDmgScalar * (1+criticalBonus) * DEFfactor * (1-defender.ShelterDmgScalar) * max(typedTakenFactor,0) * defenderPoiseFactor * igniteFactor * physicalInflictionFactor
damageFormula.igniteFactor: attacker.IgniteDamageScalar if mask intersects IgniteDamageSet else 1
damageFormula.physicalInflictionFactor: attacker.PhysicalInflictionDamageScalar if mask intersects PhysicalInfliction else 1

shield.condition: valid live shield, positive finite scale and finite input; policy flags remain active
shield.capacityCondition: valid shield buff owner, false relevant IFix, normally resolved actor ObjectPtrs and valid calculation; invalid source contributes zero; live attributes sampled during initialization
shield.containerOrder: ascending unsigned ObjectPtr.instanceUid; equal UID inserted after existing entries
shield.consumptionOrder: reverse current indices; descending UID for the unchanged ordinary container
shield.orderCondition: false AddShield IFix, normally resolved contexts, valid ObjectPtrs, no other container mutation; UID chronology separate

simpleBaseHp.condition: normal HP target, false relevant IFix, ordinary base setter, no floor/undead/server-death override or callback rewriting HP

partHp.sharedRead: mainBody HP/maxHP when useMainBodyHp; base otherwise
partHp.sharedWrite: no-op when useMainBodyHp; base setter otherwise

partTransfer.ratioPrecision: Single widened to Double before multiplication
partTransfer.settlement: ApplyTransferredModifier; immunity and HP setter without a second ordinary shield pass
partTransfer.condition: valid part/config, successful normally returning false-IFix computation/application, branch-specific ratio gates; events can change state
partTransfer.ratioGate: compiled positive-ratio checks use the stored Single epsilon, not an arbitrary >0 test

rules.allowedDamageMask: None if no requests; bitwise intersection of all request masks otherwise

tagQuery.HasAny: exists damage tag whose resolved descriptor equals or descends from a resolved query descriptor
tagQuery.HasAll: every query ID appears exactly among damage IDs
tagQuery.ExceptAll: no exact ID intersection; alternate loop order
tagQuery.condition: valid resolved collections/descriptors, default IFix; loading/hierarchy ownership separate
